note: Campground on the east shore of Sandy (Halkett) Lake near Prince Albert National Park's South Gate on Highway 263, in spruce, fir and aspen woods. Sand beach with a buoyed swim area, camp kitchen and picnic area by the lake, fish-cleaning station and boat launch. The drive-in sites are raised gravel back-ins; six more are walk-in tent sites. The nearest dump and potable-water fill is the Meridian station 3 km south on Highway 263. --Claude
summary: Keep (federal, Parks Canada). Confirmed 31 sites (25 back-ins to 27 ft + 6 walk-in tent), unserviced, pit toilets, no water, first-come self-registration. Season mid-May..mid-Sep written (05-15..09-15 with note); fees C$16.25-19.50 + fire permit. PIN MOVE ~415 m from the boat-launch day-use lot to the campground road 53.6382,-106.0684. Waterfront kept not waterfront; sites 1-7 are a possible lakeview (reviewer). Google 4.5 (71).
flags: PIN MOVE (~415 m): stored 53.6416,-106.0658 is on the grass north of the boat-launch / day-use parking at the campground's north end (Esri). The sites run SW from the entrance along the shore road: sites 27-31 near ~53.6397,-106.0659, the walk-in lot and 19-20 midway, then sites 1-7 and the 8-18 loop at the SW end around ~53.6377,-106.0693 (toilet and parking by site 7), turnaround ~53.6367,-106.0717. Proposed pin on the campground road where it leaves the trees at the picnic lawn, ~53.6382,-106.0684 (site pads are under canopy; placement read from the Parks Canada map against the imagery). Google's point 53.64052,-106.06625 is the beach lawn by the entrance.

WATERFRONT: stored 'not waterfront' kept. The Parks Canada map puts every site on the inland side of the campground road; the beach, picnic lawn and road lie between. Closest are sites 1-7 at the SW end, where the road runs along the shore: on Esri imagery the RVs there (e.g. ~53.6377,-106.0694 and ~53.6375,-106.0700) sit ~30-40 m from the water, across the road and a narrow sand strip, under canopy and behind a broken line of shoreline trees. That is at most a view; no photo from a site was seen (only a picnic-site photo on the PC page). Possible lakeview for sites 1-7 (all first-come nightly) if the reviewer wants it; under 'unsure goes down' it stays not waterfront. Sites 19-31 are behind the open picnic lawn and a tree band ~60-100 m from the water.

SEASON: written opens 05-15 / closes 09-15 from 'mid-May to mid-September' (no exact dates), with a season note, following the Namekus (9152) precedent. Index page: 'Most frontcountry campgrounds are open from mid-May until mid-October. Please contact the park directly' - Sandy Lake's own line is mid-September.
